say: Heaven Mayhem says up to 60% off. I counted the store: most pieces sit at 30. Here are six I'd open.
The Double Knot Earrings. Was $110, now $77. Plated brass, hollow so they're light. Good for the one pair that does the talking. Ends December 1.
The Bruma Choker. Was $140, now $98, in gold or silver. Plated stainless steel, open at the front. Good for a plain white tee. Ends December 1.
The Matilde Cuff. Was $100, now $70. Plated steel with a burgundy enamel center, one size. Good for a bare wrist and a black sleeve. Ends December 1.
The Tove Ring. Was $180, now $126. Two bands joined by a row of moissanite, sizes 4 to 7. Good for stacking. Ends December 1.
The Carino Watch. Was $250, now $175, and it comes with a black and a brown leather strap. Good for every day. Ends December 1.
The Gaze Choker, the gold-plated brass one. Was $480, now $384. That's 20% off, not 60. Good for an evening neckline. Everything is final sale and it ends December 1.
Which store should I count next?
caption: Heaven Mayhem Black Friday: says up to 60% off sitewide, no code. I counted: 98% of the store is marked down, most of it at 30%. Six pieces: Double Knot Earrings $77 (was $110, 30% off, plated brass) · Bruma Choker $98 (was $140, 30% off, plated stainless steel) · Matilde Cuff $70 (was $100, 30% off, plated steel with enamel) · Tove Ring $126 (was $180, 30% off, moissanite, sizes 4 to 7) · Carino Watch $175 (was $250, 30% off, two leather straps) · Gaze Choker in plated brass $384 (was $480, 20% off). All items final sale. Ends Dec 1. Prices read Nov 26-27. Commissionable links in bio.
recheck: Open each of the six product pages on posting day: price and in-stock still match (catalog read Nov 26-27).
Sale end date Dec 1 comes from the sheet, not the site; confirm on heavenmayhem.com.
Homepage says ALL ITEMS ARE FINAL SALE, but the Gaze Choker carries an 'Exchange Only' tag; check its page wording before saying final sale for it.
Gaze Choker $384 is the plated brass version only; the sterling silver version is $784 (was $980). It is 20% off, never 60.
Tove Ring: the page names moissanite but not the metal, so no metal is claimed. Double Knot footage shows the mixed-metal color; gold and silver cost the same.
'Most pieces sit at 30' = 109 of 184 in-stock products are 30-39% off; 24 are at 60%+ (none of those had video).
The pieces at 60% off had no product video, so none is in the film.
